newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria 'spot a sect' guide sells like hot cakes.
newsitem.headline: Austria 'spot a sect' guide sells like hot cakes.

text.p: Frenzied demand in Roman Catholic Austria for a government guide on how to spot religious cults has forced the family ministry into a second print run.
The guide, entitled "Sects - Knowledge Protects" and launched in November, has turned into the government's bestseller with 230,000 copies sent out so far.
The guide lists 22 names of sects active in the small Alpine republic and gives useful tips on how to recognise pseudo-religious groups and on details about their methods and practices.
Around 50,000 Austrians are believed to belong to such groups, with 200,000 more suspected of having loose links with them.
